    Profile

    Claris is a girl of noble birth who has been blessed by the High Elves of Northern Pride. She is well loved by the spirits and can channel their energy into her magic. Her unquenchable thirst for knowledge will sometimes push her past her physical limits and cause her to collapse from exhaustion.

    Origin: Northern Pride
    Gender: Female
    Height: 166cm
    Weight: 58kg
    Birthday: May 4
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Thunderous Emperor
    Likes: Knowing Things
    Hobbies: Reading, Going Out
    Illust: あやっぺ隊長（G-ROW）
    CV: 高尾奏音
